references.text: The book of Psalms highlights God's care for creation, which is similar to how God clothes the lilies of the field.
Isaiah speaks of God's word standing firm forever, in contrast to flowers that wither, which may recall Jesus' point that God takes care of the flowers.
Hebrews encourages being free from love of money and content with what one has, which resonates with Jesus' call not to worry about clothing.
Proverbs gives advice not to worry about material things, which is similar to Jesus' teaching in Matthew.
Genesis tells how God provides food for all living creatures, which can be seen as a parallel to God's care for the flowers.
